# multi_mode_auth — runtime auth selection via predicates, pagination.none
# Default state.auth_mode=api_key so the api_key branch fires.
# Boots the multi_mode_auth scenario, runs one drain, and asserts the
# trace and events match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml multi_mode_auth
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","query":{"since":"<ref cursor.last_timestamp>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","X-Api-Key":"test-api-key-67890"},"response_body":"body 348 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/multi_mode_auth/events"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
{"id":"evt-000001","seq_num":1,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
{"id":"evt-000002","seq_num":2,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:01Z"}
{"id":"evt-000003","seq_num":3,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:02Z"}
{"id":"evt-000004","seq_num":4,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:03Z"}
